## File: facebookresearch_sapiens/det/mmdet/engine/schedulers/quadratic_warmup.py

Prompts

```
['build a QuadraticWarmupLR scheduler to warm up learning rate using a quadratic formula over training steps', 'build a QuadraticWarmupMomentum scheduler to warm up momentum values using a quadratic formula over training steps', 'build an iter-based QuadraticWarmupParamScheduler instance from an epoch-based config using build_iter_from_epoch class method', 'review the QuadraticWarmupParamScheduler _get_value method to understand the quadratic warmup formula computation', 'test the QuadraticWarmupParamScheduler by verifying it raises ValueError when end parameter equals or exceeds infinity']
```

